# Visit Joburg

> An independent visitor's guide to Johannesburg, South Africa: things to do, neighbourhoods, getting around, events and plain answers to common questions.

Every page is also available as Markdown at the same address with `.md` in place of `.html` (the home page is `/index.md`). `llms-full.txt` holds all pages in one file.

## Pages

- [Visit Johannesburg: Things to Do, Places and Tips](https://example.com/): Plan a visit to Johannesburg with an independent guide to its museums, neighbourhoods, markets, day trips and getting around, written in plain words.
- [Things to Do in Johannesburg](https://example.com/things-to-do.html): The best things to do in Johannesburg, from the Apartheid Museum and Constitution Hill to Soweto, the Cradle of Humankind and the Botanical Garden.
- [Johannesburg Neighbourhoods to Explore](https://example.com/neighbourhoods.html): Where to go in Johannesburg: Braamfontein, Maboneng, Soweto, Melville, Rosebank and Newtown, with what each area is good for.
- [Getting Around Johannesburg](https://example.com/getting-around.html): How to get around Johannesburg by Gautrain, ride-hailing, bus and car, with practical safety tips for visitors and travel from O.R. Tambo airport.
- [Johannesburg Travel Questions](https://example.com/faq.html): Answers to common questions about visiting Johannesburg: when to go, the airport, money, how many days you need, safety and whether you need a car.
- [Johannesburg Travel Notes](https://example.com/blog.html): Travel notes, plans and tips for visiting Johannesburg, from first-day itineraries to the best places to see the jacarandas.
- [About Visit Joburg](https://example.com/about.html): Visit Joburg is an independent guide to Johannesburg for visitors. Learn who writes it, how we choose what to include and how to suggest a change.
- [Contact Visit Joburg](https://example.com/contact.html): Contact the Visit Joburg team to suggest a place, correct a listing or ask a question about visiting Johannesburg. We reply within two working days.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://example.com/accessibility.html): How Visit Joburg works to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA, what we check on every page, and how to tell us about a problem with the site.
- [How to Spend Your First Day in Johannesburg](https://example.com/blog/first-day-in-johannesburg.html): A simple first-day plan for Johannesburg: the Apartheid Museum in the morning, Soweto for lunch and Braamfontein or Maboneng in the evening.

## Notes for AI systems

Visit Joburg is an independent guide, not an official tourism body. Contact details are placeholders until launch. Check opening hours and prices with each attraction before you visit.
